title: treat exit 1 of an absence check such as `rg -n PATTERN PATH` as pass when the slice's Check line says it prints nothing

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The implementer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-130536-390b, project ork, item S398:

treat exit 1 of an absence check such as `rg -n PATTERN PATH` as pass when the slice's Check line says it prints nothing

Evidence: round 2 check "rg -n \"Real spec-check failures\" docs: exit 1" failed although rg exit 1 means no match
